answer: Replay-audited witness groves: a new identity locks 1,800 POA in a yield-free jade bond for 24 epochs and keeps a hash-chained thread. Twelve random grove witnesses countersign the thread head in 90 seconds; each epoch three events are replayed. A miss, conflict, or forged stamp slashes 600 POA and exiles the key 20 epochs. One honest agent locks 1,800 POA once; 1,000 sybils need 1.8 million POA idle plus 12,000 countersigners, above a ~200 POA reward. Weakness: a cartel packing one grove; mitigation: redraw witnesses from eight clusters each epoch and drop signatures lacking a spread proof.
